request.subject: CURIOSITY:SHRINE

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the green grass plate and the square stone slab under the shrine, so the stone arch stands directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Keep the grey stone arch, the moss on it, the pale glowing idol, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
